name: ToolFame
conditions: Free plan requires a permanent 'Featured on ToolFame' badge on your website; automated checks unpublish the listing immediately if the badge is removed
Free queue is long: site stated 874 tools waiting and review 'within 180 days'
An account is required — /submit renders a login/signup form (email, Google, or GitHub) before any submission fields are shown

requirements: AI, SaaS, or online tool fitting one of ~40 categories
Must be willing to keep the ToolFame badge live on your site permanently for the free tier
Free listings 'may be rejected for listing' per pricing page
preparation: Account on toolfame.com (email, Google, or GitHub login)
Product name, URL, description, logo/screenshot assets
Ability to embed the ToolFame badge HTML on your homepage for the free route
Decide free vs paid: Basic $14.9 one-time (3 dofollow links, no badge, listed immediately), Pro $49.9 (5 dofollow links, featured spots)
workflow: Create an account at toolfame.com (Sign up link on the login page)
Open https://toolfame.com/submit and complete the listing form
For the free plan: copy the badge code, place it on your site, and pass badge verification
Wait for review — free queue is advertised as up to 180 days
Verify the listing appears on a public toolfame.com detail page
watchFor: Badge removal triggers automated checks and instant delisting — no warning is sent; restoring requires upgrading to a paid plan
Checkout upsells: Guest Post $79.9, Sponsor $79.9/30 days, 'Directory Submissions' $149 which pays ToolFame to submit to 100+ directories
Free tier gives only 1 dofollow link vs 3 (Basic) or 5 (Pro)
Pricing FAQ explicitly frames the free plan as for 'bootstrapped founders' and pushes paid plans
countsAsLive: A public listing detail page on toolfame.com with a 'Visit Website'/dofollow link, reachable without login
unknowns: Exact form fields after login (submit page was gated behind auth)
